review_candidates.title: Senior Cisco Network Engineer #11639
review_candidates.description: ECCO Select is a talent acquisition and consulting company specializing in people, process and technology solutions. We provide the talent behind the technology enabling our clients to achieve their goals. For more information about ECCO Select, visit us at www.eccoselect.com. Position Title: Senior Cisco Network Engineer Location Information Onsite - Kansas City, MO Position Responsibilities: As a Senior Cisco Network Engineer, your primary responsibility will be engineering, supporting, and enhancing enterprise Cisco wireless (Wi-Fi) networks, with an additional focus on Cisco routing and switching. The role is weighted toward wireless (approximately 75%), with the remaining 25% covering core routing and switching. You will be expected to deliver hands-on technical support, actively contribute to wireless design and troubleshooting, and provide senior-level insight and mentoring for other members of the network engineering team. Specific responsibilities include: Cisco Wireless / Wi-Fi (Wi-Fi is 75% of the workload): Design and provide ongoing support for enterprise Cisco wireless networks for diverse locations including clinics and administrative spaces. Develop wireless designs for new and expanding sites, using Ekahau predictive modeling software to plan access point placement and density. Troubleshoot wireless coverage, interference, connectivity, and performance issues across various environments, including high-density requirements. Perform or assist with on-site wireless surveys when needed, interpret wireless readings, and identify/address issues or potential optimizations. Refine and improve wireless designs as projects evolve and new deployments are initiated. Document and communicate design recommendations, best practices, and procedures; mentor other engineers in wireless technologies and troubleshooting techniques. Cisco Routing & Switching (25% of the workload): Offer hands-on support, troubleshooting, and guidance for enterprise Cisco routing and switching infrastructure, including support for network upgrades and migration projects. Deliver technical expertise for Cisco Catalyst 9300 switches and border gateway routers. Review planned network modifications or upgrades and provide feedback or recommendations to optimize functionality, security, and reliability.
